ABOUT THIS WORKING MAP

Start with the source.

The Burke-Gilman portions of Parcel Ownership Map_Trails-2.pdf are reproduced as 62 selectable sections. Adjacent vector paths with the same ownership color are combined. Every ownership change—including the very short ones—is retained.

What the map tells us

Six legend categories occur on the mapped Burke-Gilman: Seattle DOT, Seattle Parks and Recreation, the University of Washington, Seattle City Light, WSDOT, and “Private Owner or Unknown.” The last category does not identify a specific private owner.

What still needs checking

The PDF does not provide parcel IDs, an ownership date, exact street boundaries, easements, access rights, maintenance agreements, trail condition, or measured lengths. An ownership label alone does not establish who maintains a section.

How to read the sections

Numbers identify sections in this page, not official parcels. Neighborhood names are approximate orientation labels added here. The gap in Ballard and the northern edge of the source are preserved; no ownership is inferred beyond them. Tiny source gaps and overlaps are also retained.

A place for observations

Issues and ideas begin with suggested questions, not verified findings. Added notes and photos are saved only in this browser, for this file or site address. Export data to keep a portable copy. Nothing is uploaded or shared automatically.

Design reference: your Fremont Connection page. Map linework and shoreline: the supplied PDF, page 1. The default map restyles the background; “Source map” shows the original colors and labels.
